scope: B06-07 E13–E15 lines 420–457; scoped local only

groups.contract: Inputs left/right positions, level, keyword-only less. Optional integer return annotation; annotations postponed, not runtime type guards. No local conversion of level or positions.

If lower_index is not exactly None (including falsey objects), select first_less(left,right,level) when less is truthy, otherwise first_greater(left,right,level); only chosen call runs. Resolve index and method dynamically, pass inputs unchanged, immediately return its exact result including None, zero or other custom-provider result. No scan retry, local bounds/empty-range checks, comparison, coercion or exception catch. Native index owns half-open strict earliest crossing and clamps left=max(0,left), right=min(length,right); if left>=right returns None. Native first_less excludes minima >= level, first_greater excludes maxima <= level, chronological segment search and left-first descent choose earliest position on valid ordinary data. Optional retained-crossing history belongs to that index, not E continuation. Reflected provider reverses comparator and negates Decimal level via copy_negate; no inferred equivalence for arbitrary providers.

Only exact None lower_index enters linear path. Choose low once for truthy less else high; iterate increasing positions in half-open range(left,right), no clamp. Empty/reversed integer range returns None without row access. For ordinary sequence, valid negative positions use Python end-relative indexing but return the original possibly negative position; too negative or past end raises IndexError if reached. A prior hit can avoid later invalid positions. Read selected lower row and required selected field only, then as_decimal; native helper returns existing Decimal unchanged, otherwise Decimal(str(value)). Supplied level unchanged. Range construction, indexing, attribute access and normalization may raise; custom sequences may differ.

For each visited row re-evaluate truthiness of less, then compare normalized value strictly < level or > level, only chosen comparison. Return original position at first true comparison; exhaustion returns None. Equality is not a crossing for ordinary finite comparable Decimal values. No tie scan, retry, main-candle fallback, error suppression or rollback; malformed types, signaling NaN or dynamic truthiness can raise. Under normal Boolean less, chosen field and comparator agree; arbitrary stateful truthiness need not.

Read policy.extreme_attr dynamically, required item attribute with no default, normalize via as_decimal, return value. Native policy bullish selects low, bearish high; helper preserves Decimal identity or converts Decimal(str(value)), no rounding or float coercion step. No hardcoded field, direction check, fallback, exception handling or local mutation. A missing attribute or invalid conversion propagates.

Read stored chronology then optional _e_main_extremes using getattr default None. Only exact None suppresses lookup, not empty/falsey mapping; otherwise call mapping.get(direction) dynamically once, using exact current direction key. Only result exactly None is miss (including absent key in native dict or explicit None); other falsey cached values enter hit path even if malformed. No local mapping creation, type/shape validation or broader key (sequence identity/length/dirty marker/range). Scope safety relies on chronology ownership and stable main sequence, not a local freshness proof.

On miss materialize fresh directional stop-value list over entire self.candles in iteration order, reading policy.extreme_attr for each row and normalizing required attribute with as_decimal. Assign list after entire comprehension succeeds. No range clipping, sorting, dedup, rounding or _stop_value dispatch. Failure during iteration/read/normalization prevents this list assignment (external effects not excluded), and prevents later steps.

After successful price assignment iterate entire candles again in order, read required index and convert int for each candle, then assign fresh candle-code list only after comprehension completes. Codes are converted source index values, not necessarily positional ordinals. No check that values/codes correspond under mutable or unusual sequences. Failure leaves earlier completed price assignment, no local rollback.

After price and code lists assigned, dynamically call _build_extreme_sparse() without arguments and assign result to detector. Native E16 reads stop values, returns empty table for empty list; otherwise stores earliest min positions for bullish or max positions otherwise, using power-of-two intervals and tie selection by smaller position when neither strict comparison wins. E16 is a bounded dependency, not new accepted partition. Failure preserves earlier assignments, no chronology publication from later statement.

Only when existing mapping is not None, evaluate current direction key and publish tuple of the detector's three current object references (prices, codes, sparse table) after all three assignments; no copies. No creation of a new mapping when absent/None. Empty mapping still receives assignment. Custom mapping or attribute operations can raise or mutate partially; no rollback. If absent, keep detector-local objects. No locking, cache invalidation or other direction publication here.

For non-None cached result unpack exactly three elements and assign attributes left-to-right, sharing the underlying objects without copying, conversion, rebuilding, type/shape/freshness checks. A falsey empty tuple/list or noniterable value can raise before stores; a falsey iterable of three objects is accepted. Unpacking failure prevents ordinary target stores, later attribute assignment can fail after earlier stores. Shared lists/table can alias other detectors through chronology; no local immutability enforcement. No retry or rollback. Method returns implicit None on successful miss or hit.
